notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition is a nonmajor governmental fund), so business_type and proprietary are null. The statement of receipts and disbursements for the governmental funds (receipts page, printed p7) is NOT in the trimmed PDF; only the disbursements continuation (p4) and balance sheet (p5) are. Receipts lines were therefore built from the fund combining/budget schedules (General Fund components p6, Special Building p19, nonmajor combining p8) and agree with p1/p2 statement of activities lines where those exist; they sum to 35,490,525 = total disbursements 32,383,603 + excess 3,106,922 (p4), marked computed. Disbursement lines: first four from p1 statement of activities (equal to total column), rest from p4. Interfund transfers (233,901) net to zero in the total column and are not recorded at top level; other_financing 1,370,230 is the printed Other line in the total column (p4; includes disposal proceeds and other nonrevenue receipts). Roll-forward: 18,898,840 + 35,490,525 - 32,383,603 + 1,370,230 = 23,375,992. Detail: budget-and-actual fund schedules pp9-24 recorded (more detailed than combining schedules pp6-8, which were not duplicated); budget columns blank so budget_final omitted; Education Agency fund has no schedule (its 1,887,260 is eliminated by reclassifications). General Fund detail totals printed include other financing (disposal proceeds, interfund loan, transfers out). Balance sheet from net position section on p3 (government-wide style statement; equals governmental funds balance sheet p5). Read pages 1-24 of 24
